_doc: The kiosk's own keyboard, the same on the Android kiosk (domain/KioskKeys.kt) and the Windows kiosk (kiosk-desktop/src/core/kioskKeys.ts). Two equal copies: pos-android app/src/test/resources and pos-server kiosk-desktop/test/fixtures. The letter rows are always left to right (the Israeli keyboard's), a special key is NAME:width (a letter is 1, a full row 10). The bottom row is listed from the start of the screen to its end (in Hebrew from the right): the language, 123, the space, the backspace. Its words are the kiosk texts named in labels (their built-in values here).
